name: shaughv-tasks
description: A local task board and project memory for Codex. Plan work, track dependencies and completion checks, and resume in a new chat with the context intact. Seven portable skills also support Claude Code and capability-aware ChatGPT handoffs.

interface.shortDescription: Your tasks and project context, ready for the next chat.
interface.longDescription: Set up a local task board with tasks-start. Search and filter work, plan milestones, choose prerequisites, and keep task plans and completion checks beside the board. Tasks and shared workplace memory stay in readable project files. Copy a saved task handoff into ChatGPT, then reconcile proposed changes in Codex. Portable skills also support Claude Code and other agents with project access.
defaultPrompt: Use tasks-start to set up my task board and project memory.
Use tasks-create to break this work into tasks with clear completion checks.
Use tasks-update to show what is blocked and what I can move forward next.
